title: Streaming vs Calculated Insights for Sub-Minute Triggers

steps.prompt: Commerce wants an engagement the moment a shopper views 3 products inside a 5-minute sliding window. Leadership will not accept next-day batch scores for this use case. Which Data 360 capability fits?

options.label: Streaming Insights with time-based sliding window aggregations over real-time event streams
options.rationale: Streaming Insights process real-time events continuously within sub-minute sliding time windows, triggering immediate downstream actions.

options.label: Calculated Insights configured with incremental hourly batch schedules on unified browse DMOs
options.distractorAntipattern: Calculated Insights run on multi-hour schedules and cannot evaluate sub-minute sliding session windows.
options.rationale: Calculated Insights are designed for periodic multidimensional batch aggregations, not real-time sub-minute event threshold evaluation.

options.label: Data Cloud Segment triggers refreshed continuously using rapid identity resolution updates
options.distractorAntipattern: Segment publishing is a periodic batch operation, not an event-driven stream processor.
options.rationale: Segment evaluation runs on schedules (typically every 12 to 24 hours) and cannot trigger real-time actions during active shopper browsing.
